description.value: Sea Harbour Restaurant is an award-winning Chinese fine dining establishment offering authentic dim sum, fresh seafood, and a live cooking station for made-to-order congees and other dishes. Located next to The Hotel at River Rock and a short walk from Bridgeport SkyTrain Station, it occupies a recently renovated contemporary space with a sophisticated ambience. A touring cyclist seeking a substantial sit-down meal would find an extensive menu spanning traditional dim sum to premium ingredients such as South African abalone and king crab.
